item.title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
item.description: The justice department has filed a lawsuit arguing that the inclusion of two candidates named Dan Sullivan could confuse voters.

item.title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
item.description: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

item.title: Bodycam clip released in fatal police shooting of Mississippi one-year-old
item.description: The family lawyer says an allegation of shoplifting "does not warrant the death" of a child.

item.title: Woman at centre of Cornell University rape inquiry in 'constant fear', lawyer says
item.description: The woman, known anonymously as Jane Doe, alleged she was drugged and raped by several men on Cornell's campus.

item.title: US justice department investigating Corey Lewandowski over DHS role
item.description: Trump's former campaign manager is reportedly being investigated for allegedly using his role at the Department of Homeland for financial gain.

item.title: Home distillers rejoice as US Supreme Court considers whether to finally legalise moonshine
item.description: The Supreme Court will consider in the new year whether the 1868 legislation forbidding home distilling should be overturned.

item.title: Hispanic voters helped bring Trump to power - in Texas, the tide may be turning
item.description: Recent polls suggest the president is facing challenging headwinds in the state ahead of the midterms.

item.title: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skincare sales
item.description: The beauty giant's CEO says the use of GLP-1s is "a very important phenomenon for us".

item.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
item.description: Trump is suing the BBC over an episode of Panorama that edited together two different sections of a speech he gave in 2021.

item.title: Watch: 'It's part of the culture' - New York bans horse-drawn carriages after more than 160 years
item.description: The BBC's Madeline Halpert spoke to city tourists, residents and horse carriage workers about the industry and their opinion on the ban.

item.title: 'This is despicable': Amy Acton responds to Ohio attack ad featuring her estranged mother
item.description: Her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy is airing the ad featuring her mother, whose husband was charged with sexual abuse in her childhood.

item.title: Prominent Virginia senator charged over allegations she ran criminal cannabis scheme
item.description: Democratic Senator L Louise Lucas and six other people, including her family members, are accused of illegally distributing the drug.

item.title: US actor Tom Skerritt, star of Top Gun, Steel Magnolias and Alien, dies aged 93
item.description: The moustachioed star of several 20th Century hit films died on Wednesday of natural causes, his family says.

item.title: Damaging hail pelts Phoenix in rare storm
item.description: Videos from the Arizona capital show people sheltering inside a car as hail smashes the windscreen, while intense downpours covered neighbourhoods in ice.

item.title: 'Let's move on': Albertans react to referendum vote
item.description: Preliminary referendum results show that more than two-thirds of Alberta voters support remaining part of Canada, easing concerns over national unity.

item.title: US church on front line of battle against drug known as 'tranq'
item.description: Synthetic opioids like fentanyl are more powerful and in plentiful supply, and they have transformed the drugs landscape.

item.title: Watch: 'A dollar on gas won't change our vote' - Iowans sticking with Trump
item.description: The BBC's Sarah Smith travelled across the state ahead of the midterms, as the president faces political headwinds.

item.title: Candlelit vigil held for Oregon school shooting victims
item.description: The vigil comes after a teacher and children aged five, eight and 11, were killed in a shooting at an elementary school in the US state of Oregon, local police say.

item.title: The real reasons there are so few young politicians in the US
item.description: No country for young men and women: why do older politicians seem to have such a tight grip on the US political system?

item.title: How likely is a merger of Tesla and SpaceX - and what would it mean for you?
item.description: Musk says there's "a lot to be gained" by combining the firms in what would be the biggest merger in history.

item.title: Haitian migrants changed this US town - Trump's deportation drive is reshaping it again
item.description: The president thrust Springfield, Ohio, into the spotlight with a false pet-eating claim - years later, it remains at the heart of the immigration debate.

item.title: 'Trash Island' or DC landmark? How a golf course got Trump in a messy legal dispute
item.description: Trump said he has plans to turn a 106-year-old public golf course in Washington DC into a tournament-capable golf course for pros, but local golfers are not happy.

item.title: Alberta's decisive decision to stay in Canada gives Carney backing to take on Trump
item.description: The overwhelming vote by Alberta to stay in Canada gives Mark Carney political capital to focus on remaking the country's economy, writes the BBC's Lyse Doucet.

item.title: How is the US economy really doing under President Trump?
item.description: Ahead of the midterms Trump has boasted about the performance of the US economy. BBC Verify looks at inflation, jobs and economic growth in the country.
